title: Twenty-two Years and One Ink Stain
subtitle: 学校与学习 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校与学习（生活与学习·学校生活与学习用品）
meta: 主题语境：学校与学习（生活与学习·学校生活与学习用品）　|　核心词汇：desk　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 desk 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1943 the headmaster ① fitted a desk that no carpenter in the town would have copied, and he said the fitting was the whole of the schoolroom. The ② desk, meaning the table and not the office, stood twenty-two years and stayed unscratched on the top; a desk, he said, is the only thing in a schoolroom that is judged by how long it is left unnamed.

Every ③ desk in that room had the same ink stain on the corner of it, and the ④ desk at the end, meaning the one they kept for the monitors and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever asked for twice. A desk, the caretaker said, is nine parts polish and one part somebody willing to sit; the headmaster said the sitting is the part that fills twenty-two years.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the desk was the whole of the department, meaning the office and not the table. The ⑥ desk, meaning the office and not any of that, is the only thing in a department that everybody telephones and nobody visits; desk, he said, is either something you fit or the only word that means both a table and an office. He said the office is the part they remember.

By 1952 the ⑦ desk had become a line in an inventory, and the inventory had become an argument about the ink stain. The ⑧ desk of the whole thing, the headmaster wrote in April, was one schoolroom and twenty-two years of sitting; desk, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to sit. She said the sitting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ desk I remember is the one at the end, which was removed in 1968 and is still described as the heaviest in the room. A ⑩ desk, the caretaker said in 1970, is the only thing that improves by being polished; every desk, she said, is an office that has agreed to look like a table. She said the office was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 书桌；课桌（指教室里摆着的那一张）
B. n. 书桌（指那张桌子本身，与那个办公处相对）
C. 固定搭配：fit a desk 装配一张书桌
D. n. 课桌（指留给级长用的那一张）
E. n. 书桌；案头（抽象总称，指一间教室的全部课桌）
F. n. 书桌（指清单上写到、被登记的那一张）
G. n. 办公处；服务台（指部门里电话联系的那个岗位）
H. n. 办公处（抽象总称，指人人打电话却无人登门的那个）

items.q: fitted a desk that no carpenter in the town would have copied
The desk, meaning the table and not the office
the desk was the whole of the department
the desk had become a line in an inventory
The desk of the whole thing
A desk, the caretaker said in 1970

answers.why: fit a desk 意为“装配一张书桌”，1943 年校长装配了一张全镇没有一位木匠肯照做的书桌。
desk 意为“书桌”，指那张桌子本身而不是那个办公处，它立了二十二年而桌面没有划痕。
desk 意为“课桌”，指那间教室里每一张课桌，每一张角上都有同一块墨渍。
desk 意为“课桌”，指留给级长用的那一张，是唯一有人要过两次的。
desk 意为“办公处、服务台”，指部门里电话联系的那个岗位，父亲说这个办公处就是那个部门的全部。
desk 意为“办公处”，指人人打电话却无人登门的那个而不是那张桌子，是部门里人人都打电话、却无人登门的东西。
desk 意为“书桌”，指清单上写到、被登记的那一张，到 1952 年这张书桌成了清单里的一行。
desk 意为“书桌、案头”，校长四月写道，整件事的案头是一间教室和二十二年的坐读。
desk 意为“书桌”，我记得的是末尾那一张，1968 年被搬走，至今仍被说成教室里最重的一张。
desk 为抽象总称，管理员 1970 年说，一张书桌是唯一会因为被擦拭而变得更好的东西。
